agent_action_policies_scope_target.name: agent_action_policies_scope_target
agent_action_policies_scope_target.value: ("agent_action_policies"."scope_kind" = 'project' AND "agent_action_policies"."project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "agent_action_policies"."user_id" IS NULL) OR ("agent_action_policies"."scope_kind" = 'user' AND "agent_action_policies"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "agent_action_policies"."project_id" IS NULL)

docs_branch_changes_content_matches_kind.name: docs_branch_changes_content_matches_kind
docs_branch_changes_content_matches_kind.value:
("docs_branch_changes"."kind" = 'upsert' AND "docs_branch_changes"."content" IS NOT NULL AND "docs_branch_changes"."content_sha256" IS NOT NULL)
       OR ("docs_branch_changes"."kind" = 'delete' AND "docs_branch_changes"."content" IS NULL AND "docs_branch_changes"."content_sha256" IS NULL)

docs_branches_name_matches_kind.name: docs_branches_name_matches_kind
docs_branches_name_matches_kind.value:
("docs_branches"."kind" = 'named' AND "docs_branches"."name" IS NOT NULL)
       OR ("docs_branches"."kind" = 'hidden' AND "docs_branches"."name" IS NULL)

docs_preview_channels_kind_fields.name: docs_preview_channels_kind_fields
docs_preview_channels_kind_fields.value:
("docs_preview_channels"."kind" = 'source_change' AND "docs_preview_channels"."provider" IS NOT NULL AND "docs_preview_channels"."change_external_id" IS NOT NULL AND "docs_preview_channels"."branch_id" IS NULL)
       OR ("docs_preview_channels"."kind" = 'branch' AND "docs_preview_channels"."branch_id" IS NOT NULL AND "docs_preview_channels"."provider" IS NULL AND "docs_preview_channels"."change_external_id" IS NULL)
